_README.purpose: Passive damage riders: talents that, WHEN OWNED by the rolling actor, add bonus damage to OTHER talents' rolls. register-skills.js wraps rollDamage; for each owned rider whose 'appliesTo' matches the damage type, it appends 'bonusFormula'. Keyed by exact talent name.

fields.appliesTo: damage type(s) this rider boosts: a single type string, an ARRAY of types, or 'any'. Types: energy | impact | keen | spirit | vital | heal.
fields.bonusFormula: Foundry roll expression added to the damage (resolves against the rolling actor, e.g. '@skills.red.mod' or '(1 + @tier)').

_README.caveats: Riders are ALWAYS-ON when owned (no trigger logic). The bonus is a flat additive term, so like the auto-added skill mod it is stripped on a GRAZE. Only use this for genuinely unconditional 'when you deal <type> damage' riders.

Kindle.note: When dealing energy damage, add additional damage equal to your Red modifier.

Mighty.note: APPROXIMATION: canon text is '+ (1 + tier) PER ACTION SPENT' on a weapon/unarmed hit; modeled here as a single (1+tier) add (the 1-action case) to physical-weapon damage types. Over-applies to any impact/keen/spirit damage, not only weapon Strikes — verify in play.

_DEFERRED._comment: Riders whose triggers the current always-on model can't express correctly. These need a Phase-3 conditional-rider model (per-action multipliers, movement/positioning triggers, ally-count, type-overrides). Left OUT of runtime on purpose.
_DEFERRED.Momentum's Edge: +Speed impact, but ONLY after moving 20ft toward the target this turn (movement trigger).
_DEFERRED.Severance: Changes attack damage TYPE to vital vs Isolated targets (type override, not additive).
_DEFERRED.Predatory Patience: +[Die] to the TEST (d20), not to damage; also regains Investiture (test rider, not damage).
_DEFERRED.Coordinated Hunt: Bonus = number of distinct attackers this round (max Rank) — depends on allies' actions.
_DEFERRED.Pack Pressure: +[Tier][Die] on a Strike, but only while flanking with an ally (positioning trigger).
collision / conditional impact riders gated on movement or hit context.
